assessments.name: Final exam
assessments.description: Final examination assessing students’ theoretical and applied understanding of unit content. The exam will cover lecture content from Weeks 1-10, as well as content and skills developed through practical and tutorial classes.

assessments.name: Assessment 1: Week 3 quiz (early feedback task)
assessments.description: Short quiz assessing students’ theoretical and applied understanding of unit content. The quiz will cover lecture content from Weeks 1–3.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 03 Due date : 23 Aug 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 30 Aug 2026

assessments.name: Assessment 2A: Competency checklist A
assessments.description: Competency checklist completed in practical classes during Weeks 1-4. Students will progressively develop and demonstrate competency in case note writing and preparation of an initial client report.

assessments.name: Assessment 3: 6-week exercise program with justification
assessments.description: Students submit a 2-page, 6-week exercise program with a justification of up to 500 words. The program should show appropriate goals, exercise prescription, progression, monitoring and safety considerations. The justification explains key decisions.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 06 Due date : 13 Sep 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 25 Sep 2026

assessments.name: Assessment 2B: Competency checklist B
assessments.description: Competency checklist completed in practical classes during Weeks 6-11. Students will develop skills in exercise instruction and continue to progressively develop and demonstrate competency in case note writing and preparation of a final client report.

assessments.name: Assessment 4A: Maximal aerobic assessment with self-reflection
assessments.description: Safely & effectively implement an aerobic fitness test and self reflect on learning (hurdle task).
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Assessment 4B: Maximal strength assessment with self-reflection
assessments.description: Safely & effectively implement a muscular fitness test and self reflect on learning (hurdle task).
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test
